description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of “FOCUS” values—specifically, the proportions assigned to “HERO,” “VICTIM,” and “VILLAIN” categories—across four political leanings. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Left bias,” “Left center bias,” “Quest. source,” and “Right bias,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, represents the proportion values, without specified units. Each of the four categories has a stacked bar, with the bottom segment colored blue representing “HERO,” a middle segment colored brown representing “VICTIM”, and the top segment colored light blue representing “VILLAIN.” For “Left bias,” the “HERO” segment reaches approximately 0.3, the “VICTIM” segment reaches approximately 0.15, and the “VILLAIN” segment reaches approximately 0.55. For “Left center bias,” the “HERO” segment reaches approximately 0.45, the “VICTIM” segment reaches approximately 0.05, and the “VILLAIN” segment reaches approximately 0.5. For “Quest. source,” the “HERO” segment reaches approximately 0.3, the “VICTIM” segment reaches approximately 0.1, and the “VILLAIN” segment reaches approximately 0.6. For “Right bias,” the “HERO” segment reaches approximately 0.3, the “VICTIM” segment reaches approximately 0.15, and the “VILLAIN” segment reaches approximately 0.55. A legend in the upper left corner identifies the color corresponding to each of the three roles. No bars are visually emphasized.
